overall_notes: This paper focuses on text-to-SQL generation robustness against synonym substitution. It uses automatic metrics (exact match accuracy, component F1) but no human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The main contribution is the Spider-Syn dataset and robustness evaluation methods. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization of model names and clarification that annotation guidelines were for dataset creation, not output evaluation.
